keyword: how much do astronauts get paid
claims: NASA astronauts are paid based on the U.S. government’s General Schedule (GS) scale.

Astronauts receive no additional hazard pay for space missions.
As of April 2026, many crew members are paid roughly $152,000 annually.
Military astronauts are detailed to NASA.
Military astronauts receive pay/benefits based on their active-duty rank.
Salaries for CSA astronauts range from approximately $97,100 to $189,600 Canadian dollars.
Astronauts do not receive bonuses for dangerous missions such as those to the Artemis II moon mission.
Astronauts receive a per diem stipend for food and incidentals while in space.
